text: {"assertions":["A plan drift bug in the VPC Terraform module was diagnosed and fixed on 2026-02-21 in infra/terraform/vpc.tf.","The plan drift issue only manifested when working with deeply nested inputs beyond six levels deep.","The bug was reproducible by running terraform plan twice consecutively without any intervening changes.","An off-by-one error in a slice bound was identified as the root cause of the plan drift.","The fix corrected the slice bound and included a property test to prevent regression.","The fix was submitted in PR #3375 on the fix/plan-drift-1 branch.","The error rate was reduced from 6.9% to less than 0.05% after applying the fix.","This plan drift issue occurred in the same area of infra/terraform/vpc.tf as earlier plan drift work, allowing context to carry over."]}
